nodes.label: DADH Project Overview (CLAUDE.md)
nodes.rationale: Central guidance file for Claude Code agents working on this repository. Provides architectural facts, constraints, and phase-by-phase design decisions.

nodes.label: DADH Telemedicine Platform
nodes.rationale: Australia-based after-hours home visiting medical service. Connects doctors, patients, and administrators. Phone number 13 99 99 displayed in logo.

nodes.label: JWT Auth + OTP via Twilio SMS
nodes.norm_label: jwt auth + otp via twilio sms

nodes.label: MUI + Bootstrap 5 / Reactstrap (Legacy UI)
nodes.rationale: Kept in place until Phase 6 migration completes; Tailwind preflight disabled to avoid conflicts.

nodes.label: Tailwind v3 + shadcn-style Design System (Phase 3+)
nodes.rationale: New design system introduced in Phase 3 to progressively replace MUI+Bootstrap without breaking legacy pages. Uses dadh-tw-root scoped reset.

nodes.label: Design Token: primary (#0D7377 dark teal)
nodes.rationale: Hardcoded hex in tailwind.config.js; CSS variable references not resolved by JIT.

nodes.label: Constraint: No @/ Path Aliases (relative imports only)
nodes.rationale: CRA does not support @/ path aliases without CRACO configuration.
nodes.norm_label: constraint: no @/ path aliases (relative imports only)

nodes.label: Constraint: lucide-react pinned ^0.475.0
nodes.rationale: lucide-react 1.x uses ESM .mjs files which break CRA's source-map-loader.

nodes.label: Constraint: No react-hooks/exhaustive-deps ESLint disable comment
nodes.rationale: eslint-plugin-react-hooks rule not registered; adding disable comment causes build failures. Use useRef flag instead.
nodes.norm_label: constraint: no react-hooks/exhaustive-deps eslint disable comment

nodes.label: Constraint: Bootstrap/Tailwind Color Conflict (use inline styles)
nodes.rationale: Bootstrap .bg-primary overrides Tailwind color utilities with !important. Fix: use inline styles for colors in new pages where Bootstrap is still loaded.
nodes.norm_label: constraint: bootstrap/tailwind color conflict (use inline styles)

nodes.label: Bug Fix: localStorage Key Isolation (patientData vs consultPatientData)
nodes.rationale: Patient session uses patientData key (wrapped {data:{...}}); doctor active consultation patient uses consultPatientData (raw object). Keys must not be mixed.
nodes.norm_label: bug fix: localstorage key isolation (patientdata vs consultpatientdata)
